have h_main : (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond).fst = 2 * x ∧ (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond).snd = 2 * (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond).fst := by
    constructor
    · -- Prove the first part: (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond).fst = 2 * x
      simp [DoubleQuadruple, DoubleQuadruple_precond, Int.mul_emod]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> aesop
    · -- Prove the second part: (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond).snd = 2 * (DoubleQuadruple (x) h_precond).fst
      simp [DoubleQuadruple, DoubleQuadruple_precond, Int.mul_emod]
      <;> ring_nf
      <;> aesop

  exact h_main
